name: raw-flex-layout
description: Layout-utility usage in DS code that should compose <Stack>, <Row>, or <Grid> instead — `flex flex-col gap-N`, `flex flex-row gap-N`, `grid grid-cols-N gap-N`, etc. These are not token violations per se, but they violate composition discipline at atom/molecule tier.

anyOf.reason: Compose <Stack> from atoms/Layout instead of `flex flex-col`.
Compose <Row> from atoms/Layout instead of `flex flex-row`.
Compose <Grid> from atoms/Layout instead of `grid grid-cols-N`.
